UPGRADE GUIDE

Soldered vs. replaceable RAM

Find out what a memory socket changes and how onboard RAM affects capacity.

Read both fields

Soldered memory is attached to the system board. Replaceable memory sits in a socket. A laptop can have both. The X280 has no RAM sockets, while the T14 Gen 2 Intel has a replaceable SO-DIMM alongside its onboard memory.

Check your installed configuration

On the T14 Gen 2 Intel, Lenovo documents 40 GB total with 8 GB onboard and a 32 GB module, or 48 GB total with 16 GB onboard and a 32 GB module. Identify your onboard capacity and check whether the socket already holds a module.

Sources

  • Lenovo PSREF · X280, Memory
  • Lenovo PSREF · T14 Gen 2 Intel, p. 3
